assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R42.
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The claim requires precertification or prior authorization that was not obtained before services were rendered.
